feat(TSK-4821): route phone home hero chat to illustration generation (#1651)

* feat(TSK-4821): route phone home hero chat to illustration generation

Phone hero chat now seeds prompt and reference images into /generate with
auto-generate, while tablet and desktop keep the canvas redirect flow.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor: reuse client image helpers in loadReferenceToDrawingStore

Replace duplicated fetch/base64 logic with getImageDataUrl and
getImageDimensionsFromBase64; clear seededInputImageId on mobile remove.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
